note: Round 2 phenotype search via Europe PMC REST (core records); every sentence copied programmatically from abstracts and asserted present. Evidence for the child's own features in BUB1B-MVA is almost entirely indirect (L0-L1); direct data are dactinomycin intolerance (L3, single case) and MVA clinical reports. Approved options by feature: tumour - vincristine/irinotecan/temozolomide (standard relapsed RMS; temsirolimus no benefit), trametinib if RAS-mutant, eribulin, selinexor (Wilms/TRIP13), chloroquine (aneuploid-selective, preclinical); kidney - hydrochlorothiazide (XLH data), citrate (no effect in preterm prevention), avoid furosemide; growth - somatropin (case-level, GH-resistance and second-tumour caution), mecasermin (MOPD II case; Seckel high IGF-1); muscle - sirolimus and denosumab (progeroid models only). PLK1/Aurora/ATR/BH3 agents and sActRIIB are not approved. All entries verified:false pending code check.
